text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager -> Dedicated pool 'resv-east-1' GPU util 99% (5m avg). Queue growth +420 in last 5m. Autoscaler error: scale_limit_reached. Affected tenants: T-ACME (enterprise), several mid-tier. See runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/resv-pool-exhaustion

maya: oncall-ack, taking lead. pinging infra/eng-runtime.

liam: I can confirm metrics. autoscaler.log shows: `ERROR autoscaler: cannot scale beyond max_replicas (20) for pool=resv-east-1`

eng-runtime: confirmed. config max_replicas=20 for resv-east-1 (safety guard for reserved capacity). we've hit it.

dave: support-alex - are customers seeing errors?

support-alex: ACME on bridge, reporting 50% error rate and long tail latency. They see 429s and timeouts. Customer bridge link: https://bridge/redwood/T-ACME

maya: mitigation options: 1) manual evict noisy sessions (targeted) 2) migrate enterprise tenant to fallback pool 3) temporary bump max_replicas (cloud quota permitting). prefer try 1 + 2 immediately.

infra-sre: we can target evictions. preemption policy exists but it's conservative. propose evict idle/long-running sessions from noisy tenant "beta-saas" (high GPU hold).

eng-runtime: tool commands:
```
# list long-running active sessions (>30m)
redwoodctl sessions list --pool resv-east-1 --filter "active>30m" --format json

# evict session
redwoodctl sessions evict --session-id <SESSION_ID> --reason "noisy-tenant-eviction"
```

liam: running list now, sample output: 
```
[{
  "session_id": "s-9a8b7c",
  "tenant": "beta-saas",
  "gpu_secs": 7200,
  "started_at": "2026-03-15T01:12:33Z"
}, {
  "session_id": "s-7b6c5d",
  "tenant": "beta-saas",
  "gpu_secs": 5400,
  "started_at": "2026-03-15T00:51:10Z"
}]
```

infra-sre: evicting targeted sessions now. running: `redwoodctl sessions evict --tenant beta-saas --filter "gpu_secs>3600"` (dry-run then exec).

ops-bot: evicted 12 sessions from tenant beta-saas. reclaimed ~3 GPU equivalents. pool util -> 92%. queue length dropped ~420 -> 190.

incident-bot: queue length trend: 420 -> 190 after evictions. 429s decreased but tail latency still elevated for ACME.

eng-runtime: starting migration for T-ACME to fallback-pool-2 (pre-warmed). Command issued: `redwoodctl pool migrate --tenant T-ACME --from resv-east-1 --to fallback-pool-2 --strategy gradual --max-inflight 50`

support-alex: notified ACME that we're performing traffic migration to reduce errors. They're on the bridge and monitoring.

dave: can we bump max_replicas temporarily? risk: cloud quota. what's the delta?

maya: request to bump to 24 (from 20) for 15m window to catch traffic while migration completes.

infra-sre: attempting patch to autoscaler config: `kubectl patch cm autoscaler-resv-east-1 -p '{"data":{"max_replicas":"24"}}'`

ops-bot: patch applied, autoscaler attempted scale but cloud API returned `QuotaExceeded: requested 24, limit 24` -> actually we need +4 quota from cloud (current hard quota 24 including reserved). escalation to cloud-ops in flight.

eng-runtime: fallback routing in place: updating routing rules to send enterprise traffic to fallback-pool-2 while original pool drains. `routes.update --tenant T-ACME --primary fallback-pool-2 --weight 80`

ops-bot: routing updated. ACME traffic now 80% -> fallback-pool-2. Observability shows migrated requests latency improved to baseline (~120ms P95). overall pool util now 88%.

maya: good. remaining work: identify and remediate noisy tenant (beta-saas), review autoscaler guards (max_replicas vs cloud quota), add routing circuit-breaker to avoid one tenant saturating entire reserved pool, and postmortem.

dave: agree. action items:
- infra to open cloud quota ticket and track (ETA?)
- eng-runtime to implement tenant-level circuit breaker (limit concurrent sessions per tenant)
- support to follow up w/ACME and provide RCA timeline

support-alex: ACME updated: errors dropping, they want ETA for full restoration. told them we'll follow up with timeline and PS on next steps.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will follow up with postmortem. tagging #oncall #incidents :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks team. I'll own the postmortem. scheduling 1hr bridge to capture timeline and next steps.

sara: leaving note: please also check Dedicated reservations accounting - ensure reserved commits vs autoscaler config aligned.

dave: closing comments: no customer data impact observed, only latency and throttling. escalate any regression to urgent.

ops-bot: Incident closed for paging, monitoring for 1h.
